<h1 align="center">Castaway <sub><i>(working title)</i></sub></h1>

<p align="center">
  <b>One island. One palm. Ten hours. Almost nothing happens, on purpose.</b><br>
  A lo-fi video in which she idles, nods to the music, and every so often something happens.
</p>

<p align="center">
  <kbd>SYMMETRY</kbd> quad
  &nbsp;·&nbsp;
  <kbd>PULSE SPEED</kbd> 80 BPM
  &nbsp;·&nbsp;
  <kbd>BUFFER LENGTH</kbd> 10:00:00
  &nbsp;·&nbsp;
  <kbd>NIGHT</kbd> off
</p>

**Castaway** is a stationary-frame lo-fi video for YouTube, in the spirit of the ten-hour lofi streams: a young woman alone on a tiny island with one tall palm, a raft and a lot of time. She mostly idles, nodding to the music on her headphones. Every so often something happens: a message in a bottle washes straight back, a drone delivers a parcel that turns out to be another pair of headphones, a coconut lands on a hermit crab and the crab walks off wearing it. More than 90 activities live in [activities.toml](activities.toml), most of them on four timers, and each one starts on the next bar of the music, so every gag lands on the beat.

The banner is a light synth, and like the real ones it takes no audio input: it pulses at 80 BPM on faith. That makes it exactly as informed about the soundtrack as everyone else, because every sound in Castaway is synthesized from code by [tools/make_audio.py](tools/make_audio.py) and nobody has listened to it yet.

```sh
python tools/serve.py
# then open http://127.0.0.1:8765/
```

Live preview in the page, then export a YouTube-ready MP4: 16:9, 1080p, 30 fps, always daytime. In development: no video has been published yet.

<p>
  <sub>An unofficial remake, inspired by the small-island routines and visual comedy of <i>Johnny Castaway</i>, the 1992 desert-island screensaver, and not affiliated with it or its owners. Sunny, hand-painted coastal anime.</sub>
</p>

<details>
<summary><b>PRESETS</b>: keys 1 to 5, and what each seed is on the island</summary>

```text
 KEY  PRESET         ON THE ISLAND
 ───  ─────────────  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  1   PALM           One tall palm. One bar of signal, at the very top. A
                     lookout for her, and a place for a cat to nap.
  2   RIPPLE         The shore waves (built, always on), and the bottle
                     that washes straight back.
  3   TURTLE         A sea turtle, who visits.
  4   DRONE          A delivery drone. The parcel is more headphones.
  5   KUMARA         Planted once. Grows for the rest of the video.

  S   SYMMETRY       QUAD. Four of everything, except her.
  P   PULSE SPEED    80 BPM. Seeds land on the beat, gags on the bar.
  B   BUFFER LENGTH  10:00:00 by default, seed 1992.
  H   COLOURS        White, yellow, orange, pink, violet, sky, cyan.
  -   NIGHT          Not fitted. It is always daytime here. House rule.
```

Every seed grows outward in seven levels, one level a step, each level in the next colour of the sequence. Then it holds, hollows out from the middle, and the last ring runs off and goes. Which is also roughly how a gag works.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>BURSTS</b>: the things that happen, now and then</summary>

<br>

Between idles she keeps busy: coconut sipping, fishing, jogging laps, a sandcastle that the tide takes, waving for rescue, and some bushcraft (fire by friction, a hammock, a lookout up the palm, spear fishing). She plants a kumara, and it grows over the course of the video.

Now and then, visitors:

- **The bottle.** A message in a bottle washes straight back. Later, a different bottle brings a reply.
- **The delivery drone.** Brings a parcel. The parcel is another pair of headphones.
- **The sea turtle.** Visits.
- **The stray cat.** A grey tabby with a white chest arrives on a crate, climbs the palm, naps, and one day floats away again. It comes back another time.
- **The signal hunt.** There is one bar of signal on the island, at the top of the palm.
- **The shark.** Wears headphones. Nods to the beat.
- **The tour boat.** Full of selfie-takers.
- **The hermit crab.** A coconut falls on it, and then the coconut walks off with the crab wearing it.
- **The hydrofoil.** A bro on an electric hydrofoil waves with a shaka and carves off.
- **The walk.** She could leave any time. Once in a long while she walks out over the water and comes back with an iced coffee.
- **The ship.** Sails past while she is busy. It even waits for her to get busy. The light synth would like it known that it was not consulted.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>SEQUENCER</b>: four timers and a great deal of calm</summary>

<br>

[activities.toml](activities.toml) listed 94 activities at the last count on 2026-10-01 (81 on four timers, 13 chained follow-ups) and gains more every few hours. In a typical 10-hour run (the median of 200 simulated runs):

| Timer | Comes round every | Events in a 10-hour run |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Regular | 2 to 5 minutes | about 155 |
| Occasional | 12 to 25 minutes | about 30 |
| Rare | 30 to 60 minutes | about 13 |
| Super rare | 3 to 6 hours (at most 3 a run) | about 2 |

Plus chained follow-ups, such as the tide that comes for each sandcastle. She is busy about a third of the time and idles the rest. Lanes let things overlap, so a ship can sail past while she deals with a coconut. Every activity starts on the next bar of the music, every 3 seconds. The default run is 10:00:00 with seed 1992.

The scene keeps its own time too: 26 entries, 4 always-on effects and 22 timed events. Shore waves and drifting cloud shadows are built; distant birds, planes with vapour trails, whale pods, dolphins, sailboats, sandpipers, a gecko and a rain shower are planned.

```sh
python tools/schedule.py           # validate, then simulate a 10-hour run
python tools/render_demo.py --dev  # dev reel of every activity, with a HUD
```

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>AUDIO INPUT: NONE</b>: the sound, which is synthesized and so far unheard</summary>

<br>

- Every sound is synthesized from code in [tools/make_audio.py](tools/make_audio.py): no samples, loops or recordings, so no third-party licence applies. More than 150 sound files so far.
- The theme is a seamless 60-second loop at 80 BPM in F major (a ii-V-I-vi progression): 20 bars of exactly 3 seconds, with electric piano, a kalimba lead, soft drums and vinyl crackle. The ocean ambience is a seamless 60-second loop as well.
- The mix sits at -14 LUFS with true peak at or below -1 dBTP, and levels are adjustable in master and per routine.
- Nobody has listened to any of it yet. The banner pulses along regardless, one 15-second loop being five bars of the theme.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>THE MACHINE</b>: what actually runs it</summary>

<br>

```text
 RENDERER ...... web/index.html, plain ES modules, no build step
 SERVER ........ tools/serve.py on 127.0.0.1:8765
 VIDEO ......... WebCodecs H.264 in the browser, frame-exact
 SPEED ......... 68 to 78 frames a second at 1080p30 in Chrome
 SOUND ......... mixed by the server, joined into one MP4
 NPM PACKAGES .. none
 MOTION ........ hard cuts and stepped movement
 PLOT .......... minimal
```

The web page ([web/index.html](web/index.html)) is the renderer. [tools/render_demo.py](tools/render_demo.py) is the older Python reference renderer, kept for its dev reel. Working notes and decisions live in [MUSING.md](MUSING.md).

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>ABOUT THIS BANNER</b>: how the light synth is wired</summary>

<br>

The look is a mid-1980s 8-bit light synthesizer, the joystick toy people played along to records: a black screen, a cursor, and a trail of pattern seeds that grow, change colour and fade, mirrored into a mandala on a coarse block grid, with a one-line status readout and a graduated bar at the bottom.

- **The grid.** 80 by 26 cells. The cursor runs a closed path at constant speed and loops every 15 seconds, which is five bars of the theme.
- **The pulse.** Seeds drop on the beat at 80 BPM. Some presets drop a steady stream and paint rainbow wakes; others drop one or two a beat and leave rows of jewels.
- **The seeds.** Each grows outward in seven levels, one per step, each level in the next colour of a seven-colour sequence, then hollows out and fades. Each seed's colours start one step on from the last beat's, so the trail reads as a rainbow ripple.
- **The symmetry.** Quad: the whole trail is mirrored through both axes.
- **The readout.** CASTAWAY in an 8x8 font drawn for this banner, the current seed shape, and one variable per bar with a graduated bar that wipes in to its value.
- **Kind to eyes.** A cell changes only when a ring passes over it, the overall brightness stays level and nothing blinks. With reduced motion switched on, the banner holds on its first frame.

No program's seed shapes, font, palette order or words were copied: the five seeds, the font and every readout are new. Rebuild the art with `node src/95-light-synth_opus_5.5.mjs`.

</details>
